versions.document:
---
type: requirement
id: acme-keeps-each-order
kind: behavior
text:
  - ACME keeps each order that a customer sends.

---
type: requirement
id: an-order-survives-a-restart
kind: behavior
parent: acme-keeps-each-order
text:
  - ACME keeps each stored order after the order service starts again.

---
type: requirement
id: an-order-survives-a-restart
kind: behavior
parent: acme-keeps-each-order
text:
  - ACME keeps each stored order and its state after the order service starts again.

---
type: check
id: a-restart-keeps-each-order
serves: an-order-survives-a-restart
subject: code
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: example.com/acme/orders TestARestartKeepsEachOrder
  job: go-checks
claim: The order service reads each stored order after it starts again.
procedure_text:
  - The program stores one order, starts the order service again and reads the orders.
  - It must find the order one time.
failing_example:
  - An order service that keeps its orders in memory only.

---
type: requirement
id: orders-reach-billing-only-through-the-interface
kind: structure
parent: acme-keeps-each-order
about:
  - orders-to-billing
text:
  - The order service sends each order to billing only through the interface between them.

---
type: check
id: no-order-skips-the-interface
serves: orders-reach-billing-only-through-the-interface
subject: graph
procedure: query
claim: No order goes from the order service to billing outside the interface.
procedure_text:
  - The query returns each order that goes to billing outside the interface.
  - It must return none.
failing_example:
  - A copy of the graph with one order that goes to billing outside the interface.

---
type: component
id: billing
name: Billing
kind: component
purpose:
  - It sends a bill for each order.

---
type: component
id: orders
name: Orders
kind: component
purpose:
  - It keeps the orders that customers send.

---
type: component
id: orders-to-billing
name: Orders to billing
kind: interface
joins:
  - billing
  - orders
purpose:
  - Orders sends each order to billing through it.

---
type: component
id: shipping
name: Shipping
kind: component
purpose:
  - It sends the products of each paid order.

---
type: term
id: order
name: order
definition:
  - An order is a request of a customer for one or more products.
